name: 皮波拉·齿钳
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_三_繁荣的年月.md:3618
who: Pipola Gearpincer, a goblin mill-mender of the windmill-lamp town who held a reversed mill axle still for three days with her bare hands and a pair of pincers, twenty-two; her name froze then and she will always look just grown: about 119 cm, small and light-boned, able to slip into the gap under a millstone, with a grown young woman's face, not a child's. Pale mint-green skin. Bright yellow curly hair tied in a short bunch. Lake-blue eyes. A pair of long, pointed ears swept back. A pair of toothed pincers longer than her forearm at her belt; sweets in crinkled paper in her pockets. A quick, frank, stubborn air; she hates being bent down to and offered sweets.
build: 119 cm, small, light-boned and nimble, with a grown young woman's proportions.
palette: bright yellow and lake blue, pale mint green, mill-dust cream, brass and sailcloth beige
casual: Her mill-mender's clothes: a sleeveless canvas work dress over a long-sleeved cream shirt with the sleeves rolled, a heavy leather apron with many tool pockets, sweets in crinkled paper poking out of one; brown trousers tucked into small sturdy boots; the long toothed pincers hanging from her broad belt; a scrap of torn sailcloth sewn on as a patch at one knee. One hand on the pincers' handle, she looks up with a frank, unimpressed look.
private: Tinkering at home: a loose cream wool sweater with long sleeves, a short brown skirt over thick knitted stockings, bare feet, the yellow curls loose. She holds a little wooden model cart with a sail and three tiny brakes, testing a brake lever with one finger, a pleased, absorbed look.
battle: Seizing the reversed axle, in a mill-mender's war kit: a small fitted half-cuirass of riveted mountain-copper plates over the leather apron, bought secondhand and refitted to her size, its edges engraved with gear-wheel runes that glow pale gold; a single round copper pauldron on the right shoulder; thick leather gauntlets reinforced with brass knuckle rings; a crystal-filter breathing mask pushed up on the forehead under the curls; a wind crystal case and a fire crystal case hanging at the belt, softly lit. She grips the long toothed pincers in both hands, jaws clamped forward, rings of tiny gold light circling her fingers and running up her arms, the feet braced, a stubborn, fierce look.
formal: At the guild hall on the day of her emblem rite: a short dark blue wool jacket with brass buttons over a cream blouse, a full brown skirt to the shins, clean small boots, the yellow curls brushed and tied with a blue ribbon, the pincers polished at her belt. She stands very straight with her arms folded, a proud, slightly embarrassed look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the lake-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer, a sweet in crinkled paper held up between two fingers as if she is the one offering it. Warm golden mill-dust light from one side and cool grey wind-light on the other. Foreground blur: turning wooden cogs, a scrap of sailcloth and the toothed jaws of the pincers. She wears the canvas work dress and the leather apron.
gear: 极境（估）｜贫｜照常｜3档｜597年名字凝住时离凡人的顶上还远，估极境；风车灯镇学修磨的穷学徒，到了极境家境至多减一档，照第三档写成二手山铜半身甲改小，招牌是那把齿钳和攥出来的金环。

name: 西坡的营官
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_三_繁荣的年月.md:3645
who: The officer of the west-slope section of the long wall, an old fire-horn demon-kin of the horn city's legion, who in the year 318 passed torches across the wall all night and said fire does not count as soldiers; nobody on the east side ever asked his name, his own men just call him Officer: about 190 cm, broad, weathered and still upright, looking about sixty. Two long dark red horns sweeping back; the LEFT horn (on the viewer's right when he faces us) was broken once and rejoined, its middle wrapped tight with bright copper wire; the right horn is whole. Deep russet skin. Iron-grey hair cropped short and a grey moustache. Narrow ember-orange eyes. A dry, unhurried, sly air.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old demon-kin officer's face of about sixty, weathered and dry: narrow ember-orange eyes under heavy grey brows, deep lines at the eye corners and across the brow; a strong hooked nose; a short grey moustache; a thin, closed, faintly amused mouth. Deep russet skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft dark red-brown.
build: 190 cm, broad and weathered, thick through the shoulders, still upright.
palette: legion black and dark red, deep russet, bright copper wire, iron grey, torch orange
casual: His legion dress: the black leather armour of the horn city's legion, its chest branded with the city's mark, two thick iron plates on the shoulders, over a dark red wool shirt; a broad belt with a short heavy sword in a plain scabbard; dark trousers and heavy boots; a black wool officer's cloak. He holds a burning torch upright in one hand, a dry, considering look.
private: Off duty in the wall barracks: a loose dark red wool shirt open at the throat, black trousers, soft boots. He holds a tin mug of hot spiced wine in one hand and touches the copper wire on his horn with the other, a dry, amused look.
battle: On the west-slope wall at night, in a legion officer's full kit: black leather armour faced with riveted plates of black obsidian steel, the horn city's mark branded on the breastplate with a dull blue sheen from the blue-flame quench; two thick iron pauldrons rimmed with ember-red runes; a legion badge at the breast sealed with a glowing dark-red contract sigil; obsidian-steel buttons, iron-plated bracers, a black wool officer's cloak; a repeating musket slung on his back and the short heavy sword at his hip. He holds a blazing torch out at arm's length as if passing it across the wall, a dry, steady look.
formal: At the legion's muster in the horn city: a black wool officer's coat with a high collar buttoned to the throat, dark red cuffs and piping, black obsidian-steel buttons, the legion badge with its contract sigil, a broad black belt, polished boots. He stands at ease with his hands behind his back, a sly, patient look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the narrow ember-orange eyes looking at the viewer with a dry, knowing half-smile. Orange torchlight from one side and cold night blue on the other, the copper wire on his horn catching the light. Foreground blur: a line of torches handed along a wall top and drifting sparks. He wears the black legion armour with the iron pauldrons.
gear: 极境（估）｜中｜照常｜3档｜西坡一截的老营官，页上没写位阶，估极境；角城军团的制式黑皮甲加黑曜钢甲片、连发长枪（西边约300年起），318年西边还没有电，不写绝缘护手；招牌是缠铜丝的角和递过墙的火把。

name: 沃恩的祖母
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_三_繁荣的年月.md:3820
who: Vaughn's grandmother, a wood elf of the root-sworn families, who swore an oath on the roots at a hundred and kept a root-house in the tunnels beside the Sanctuary of Purification for eight hundred years, and on the night it fell was the last one to walk out; over nine hundred, so old that even an elf shows it: about 155 cm with her back bent, thin and frail but steady. Long hair white as the fluff under root bark, braided into a coil. Eyes still bright, the warm amber of pine resin, like her grandson's. Long pointed ears. A single smooth round wooden bead ground from a root knot hangs at her neck on a thread. A slow, kindly, stubborn air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a very old elven woman's face, small and fine-boned, deeply lined, soft creases around the eyes and mouth; bright, clear amber eyes; thin white brows; a small nose; a kind, firm mouth. Pale skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft warm grey.
build: 155 cm, small and bent at the back, thin, steady on her feet.
palette: root-fluff white and bark brown, moss green, resin amber, faded leaf grey
casual: Her root-keeper's dress: a long moss-brown wool robe that closes down the front with small wooden buttons, fitted sleeves, a faded leaf-grey knitted shawl around her shoulders, soft felt slippers; the root-knot bead at her neck. She stands with her bent back, one palm held flat at her side as if resting on a wall of living root, a calm, settled look.
private: In her new root-house: a long-sleeved soft undyed wool dress, the grey shawl, bare feet, the white braid let down over one shoulder. She holds a small cup of warm herb water in both hands, a mild, contented smile.
battle: Walking out of the root tunnels on the last night: the moss-brown robe and shawl under a hooded cloak of root-dyed wool, felt slippers. She walks bent, one palm held flat at her side as if on a root wall, the other hand holding the cloak closed; she carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit for the night the sanctuary fell: the moss-brown robe and shawl under a hooded cloak of root-dyed wool, felt slippers; she walks bent, her right palm held flat at her side as if guiding herself along a root wall, the left hand holding the cloak closed, a steady, unafraid look; she never fights and holds no weapon.
formal: At the planting of the new root-houses in the outer ring of the sleeping tree court: a long robe of deep green wool embroidered at the hem with a band of small roots in faded gold, the grey shawl pinned with a wooden brooch, soft slippers, the white braid coiled and pinned. She stands as straight as her back allows, the hands folded, a grave, gentle look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the bright amber eyes looking at the viewer kindly, her worn old hand pressed flat against the shining bark of a root wall beside her face. Warm amber glow of a small root-lamp from one side and cool green dusk from the tunnel on the other. Foreground blur: hanging root hairs, drifting motes of bark and a small round wooden bead on a thread. She wears the moss-brown robe and the leaf-grey shawl.
gear: 启源（估）｜中｜不打仗｜1档｜九百多岁守根屋的老根誓，不打仗，写 battle_pose，第三格是那一夜按着根壁走出根道的那一身，不披甲，原句交回。

name: 阿弗朗·灼岩
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_二_共约的年月.md:2279
who: Afran Scorchrock, a fire-horn demon-kin legend of the empire, called the Beacon Chain, who has kept the western beacon lines for well over a century and looked about thirty all that time: about 198 cm, solid in the chest and back, with long, deft fingers that can pick up a glass bead the size of a grain of rice. Skin with a warm reddish cast. Two red horns curving back, darker toward the tips; the LEFT horn (on the viewer's right when he faces us) has a white streak worn by sand wind. Black hair tied at the nape. Gold-brown eyes that shine bright by firelight. No guild emblem: he never stood for the guild's rite. A bright, slightly cocky air that never jokes about other people's lives.
build: 198 cm, broad and solid: a thick chest and back, strong arms, long fingers.
palette: beacon red and ember orange, warm red-tinted skin, gold-brown, obsidian black with a blue sheen, a little sea-blue glass
casual: His imperial keeper's dress: a black wool coat cut to the knee with black obsidian-steel buttons and dark red cuffs, worn open over a dark red linen shirt, black trousers and sand-wrapped boots; a broad belt hung with a pair of small glassmaker's tongs and a leather pouch of glass beads; the long iron beacon lamp-hook, its brass oil cup engraved with runes, slung across his back. He holds a single glass bead up between two long fingers against the light, a cocky, pleased grin.
private: In his room in the beacon fort: a loose undyed linen shirt open at the throat, the sleeves pushed up, black trousers, bare feet, the hair untied. He holds a palm-sized dark glass ball up to the light, frowning at its colour, a stubborn, boyish look.
battle: Kindling the beacon chain across the ridge, in an imperial legend's war harness: a tall-collared cuirass of black obsidian steel quenched in the horn city's blue volcanic flame, a deep blue sheen across the plates and gold-red fire runes cut along every edge; great layered pauldrons shaped like banked flames; black insulated gauntlets banded with obsidian-steel rings; a long dark red war cloak lined with ember orange, its hem glowing like a bed of coals. He grips the iron beacon lamp-hook, its rune-cut brass cup blazing, and lowers his head so both red horns point forward, flame pouring up the horns, a gold-red crack of light glowing at his breastbone, a dark-red sheen of fire-armour rising over his neck, a fierce, laughing look.
formal: At the emperor's hall: a long black wool court coat with a high collar buttoned to the throat, dark red silk lining and piping, black obsidian-steel buttons, an imperial order of red enamel and gold at the breast, a broad black sash, white gloves, polished boots. He stands very upright, chin up, a proud, slightly cocky look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the gold-brown eyes bright as he grins at the viewer, fire running up his red horns. Strong orange beacon light from one side and the cold blue of a sand-dark sky on the other. Foreground blur: a chain of beacon fires on far ridges, drifting sparks and a small black glass bead held between two fingers. He wears the black wool keeper's coat.
gear: 传奇（撼世）｜中｜照常｜5档｜约390年到传奇，照撼世，英雄往上不看家境：角城蓝焰淬的黑曜钢甲，约400年以后西边有了电，配黑漆绝缘护手；招牌照旧是烽灯灯钩和烧珠的小钳。他没让公会的秘仪照过，胸口不挂旅印。

name: 萨伊琳·苔隙
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_二_共约的年月.md:2263
who: Sailin Mosscleft, a wood elf legend of the outer forest guard, called the Spring Beneath the Arrow, who once called springs out of living roots with her arrows to stop a forest fire and now teaches young rangers to find water; she has looked just over twenty for centuries: about 172 cm, tall, slender and long-limbed, with supple shoulders and arms. Long hair dark green like wet moss, coiled over one shoulder and falling loose to the waist. Pale amber eyes. Long pointed ears; the tip of her LEFT ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us) has a small notch torn by a thorn, the right ear is whole. She goes barefoot on damp earth. No guild emblem: she never stood for the guild's rite. A gentle, curious air.
build: 172 cm, slender and long-limbed: supple, strong shoulders and arms, a D-cup, a narrow flat waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: moss green and bark brown, pale amber, spring-water blue-white, yew red-brown, a little silver leaf
casual: Her outer-forest guard gear: moss-dyed leather armour worn soft, a long grey-green cloak with a ring of small dry leaves sewn round its hem, a quiver of green-fletched arrows at her hip, the tall yew longbow slung across her back with its curved limbs clearly visible; seed pouches at the belt; bare feet with soft leather ankle wraps. She holds up a broad green leaf in one hand to show what is underneath it, a gentle, curious smile.
private: At home in the forest market: a loose long-sleeved dress of dyed sage-green wool, a narrow satin ribbon in the dark green hair, bare feet. She holds up a pair of small hollow brass beads on a thread, the earrings that only ring, letting them swing, an amused, fond smile.
battle: Calling a spring out of the forest's roots, in a legend's outer-guard war gear: armour of moss-dyed leather layered with plates of living heartwood grown to her shape, edged with mountain-copper and carved with spring runes that glow a cool blue-white; pauldrons of overlapping bark-like scales; a long hooded grey-green mantle sewn with a ring of fresh leaves that never wither, its lining shimmering like running water; a stiff bracer on the bow arm. She draws the tall yew longbow to her cheek, the string and the nocked arrow wound with a cord of glowing spring water that coils up both limbs, bare feet set apart with leather ankle wraps, a calm, fierce look.
formal: At the gathering of the outer forest guard: a long sleeveless overdress of fine moss-green wool over a long-sleeved cream shift, embroidered at the hem with a band of small silver leaves, a belt of braided bark cord, a wreath of oak leaves and a satin ribbon in the coiled hair, soft leather slippers. She stands very upright with the hands folded, a quiet, warm look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale amber eyes looking at the viewer with a gentle, curious smile, a broad green leaf held up near her face. Soft green forest light falling through leaves from above and a cool blue-white gleam of spring water on one side. Foreground blur: hanging leaves, a pair of small hollow brass beads on a thread and drops of water. She wears the moss-dyed leather armour and the leaf-hemmed cloak.
gear: 传奇（撼世）｜中｜照常｜5档｜约400年到传奇，照撼世，英雄往上不看家境；繁荣的年月她在外林守望军，照守望军苔色皮甲、碎叶斗篷、紫杉长弓往这一纪顶上那一档长；没让公会照过，胸口不挂旅印。

name: 托卢恩·灰鳞
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_二_共约的年月.md:2271
who: Tolun Greyscale, a dragonborn legend of the iron-grey scale line, called the Mountain of the Wind-Gap, who still walks the snowfield beside the herders' wagons and has looked in his twenties for well over a century: about 221 cm, a huge frame, shoulders broad enough to block a narrow door. Large iron-grey scales on the sides of his neck and down both arms. Thick, low horns sweeping back from the temples. Short, rough hair almost silver-white. Steel-grey eyes with a dark blue cast and slit pupils. A thin frost-crack scar across the bridge of his nose. He always leaves his neck bare. No guild emblem: he never stood for the guild's rite. A plain, warm, unhurried air.
build: 221 cm, huge and heavy-boned: very broad shoulders and back, a deep chest, thick arms.
palette: iron grey and snow white, dark blue, pale dragon-bone ivory, felt brown, a little faded herder red
casual: His herders' escort clothes: a long thick coat of white snow-ox felt edged with grey fur, open at the collar so his scaled neck is bare, the sleeves cut off at the elbow so the iron-grey scales of his forearms show, a broad woven sash of grey and faded red with a small carved wooden boat tucked in it; fur-lined boots bound with thongs; a crystal-filter wind mask hanging loose at his chest. He holds the long iron-shod ice pole upright in one hand, a calm, kindly look.
private: Back from his first sight of the sea: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, felt trousers, bare feet. He holds a small wooden boat with a new linen sail in both big hands, a shy, proud grin.
battle: Raising a wall against the winter, in a legend's plain snow-guard harness: a heavy long cuirass of pale dragon-bone plates bound with mountain-copper, unadorned except for wind-breaking runes that glow frost-white along the edges, a wide gorget left open at the throat, a long mantle of white snow-ox felt rimed with frost, a plated felt kilt and iron-shod boots; the ice pole slung across his back. Both arms are spread wide, bare from the elbow, palms out flat as if bracing two walls of rock, the iron-grey scales of his forearms standing up and rimed with hard ice, a towering grey-white dragon-spine shadow rising behind his back as tall as a mountain, a steady, patient look.
formal: At the herders' spring gathering: a long coat of white felt with a broad red-and-grey woven band at hem and cuffs, a wide leather sash with an iron buckle, the collar open on the scaled neck, polished fur boots, a child's woven charm tied round the base of his RIGHT horn (on the viewer's left when he faces us). He stands very upright, a shy, pleased look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark-blue-grey eyes looking down at the viewer with a quiet smile, frost in his silver-white hair. White blizzard light on one side and the warm glow of a wagon lantern on the other. Foreground blur: a line of covered wagons in the snow, swirling snowflakes and a small wooden boat. He wears the white felt coat.
gear: 传奇（撼世）｜中｜朴素｜5档｜约400年到传奇，照撼世；人朴实，跟着牧民的车走，用的是好料子（龙骨板、山铜扣、雪牛毡），样子不加装饰；没让公会照过，不挂旅印。

name: 索瑞克·苍鳞
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_三_繁荣的年月.md:3548
who: Soric Palescale, a horned and winged dragonborn of the pale-silver line, who nailed a sliding mountainside of snow in place above nine villages with his own shed scales and is called the Nail of the Snow Slope; a legend who has looked in his twenties ever since: about 194 cm, broad-shouldered and narrow-waisted. Short tousled hair of pale frost-silver with a faint blue tint. Pale gold eyes with slit pupils. Two swept-back pale silver horns. A pair of large pale-silver dragon wings; the outermost bone of the LEFT wing (on the viewer's right when he faces us) has an old crack. Pale silver scales along the jaw, the neck and the backs of his hands. A leather pouch of old shed scales at his belt. A gentle, patient air; he mends other people's boots.
build: 194 cm, broad-shouldered and narrow-waisted, lean and strong, with flight muscles across the back.
palette: pale frost silver and ice blue, pale gold, snow white, worn boot-leather brown
casual: His mountain guide's clothes: a fitted grey-blue wool coat to mid-thigh with two slits in the back for the wings, closing down the front with horn buttons, dark trousers and well-mended mountain boots; a leather pouch of old shed scales and a small roll of boot-mending tools at his belt; on his chest the guild's bronze emblem of a seven-pointed star within a ring, glowing faintly. He holds a worn child's boot in one hand, checking its sole, a gentle, attentive look.
private: Mending boots on a rest day: a loose cream wool shirt with the sleeves rolled and slits for the wings, dark trousers, bare feet, the wings folded. He holds a boot in one hand and an awl in the other, pulling a waxed thread tight, a calm, content smile.
battle: Nailing the snow slope, in a legend's silver war harness: a fitted cuirass and tassets of pale silver dragon-scale plates set in frost-white mountain-copper, every scale edged with glowing silver rune lines, the back cut open to free the wings; layered pauldrons like overlapping frozen scales; plated bracers; a short pale blue mantle pinned at both shoulders between the wings; the glowing star emblem at his breast. He holds a fan of old shed scales between the fingers of one raised hand, each shining like a silver nail, and presses a single thin scale forward with the other, his great wings spread wide, silver frost lines spreading across the plates, a calm, resolute look.
formal: At the guild's rite of the emblem: a long pale grey dress coat with a high collar, silver piping and slits for the wings, the glowing star emblem at the breast, a white sash, polished boots. He stands very upright with the wings folded neatly, a modest, slightly embarrassed look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale gold slit-pupil eyes looking at the viewer kindly, a single thin, almost transparent scale held up between two fingers so light shows through it. Cold silver dawn light on snow from one side and the warm glow of village windows far below on the other. Foreground blur: driving crystal snow, a line of silver scale-nails and a small leather pouch. He wears the grey-blue wool coat.
gear: 传奇（撼世）｜中｜照常｜5档｜471年凝名、到撼世，照这一纪顶上那一身：苍银鳞片镶山铜的翼甲，背后开口放翼，招牌是攒了几十年的旧鳞当钉子；472年照过秘仪，胸口挂圣歌阶的七芒星旅印。

name: 瑟穆恩·镜纱
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_三_繁荣的年月.md:3558
who: Semun Mirrorgauze, a nightmare demon-kin who once played undying kings on a travelling stage and, over three foggy nights, laid out his own shadow across three miles of grass to put an army of old war echoes back to sleep; he is called the Shadow-Spreader and has looked about thirty all his life: about 188 cm, thin and very upright. Straight dusky violet-purple hair falling to the shoulder blades. Wine-red eyes. A pair of short dark horns half hidden in his hair. Under a lamp his shadow lies a little deeper than other people's. A courteous, theatrical, gentle air; he finishes other people's unfinished dreams for them.
build: 188 cm, thin, long-limbed and very upright, with an actor's straight carriage.
palette: dusky violet and wine red, night black, faded royal gold, lamp amber
casual: His travelling player's clothes: a long dark violet coat with tarnished gold braid at the cuffs, closing down the front with buttons, a faded wine-red waistcoat and a cream shirt, dark trousers and soft boots; a small stage lantern at his belt; on his chest the guild's bronze emblem of a seven-pointed star within a ring, faintly glowing. He holds a little stuffed cloth bird with a yawning beak in one hand, as if about to give it to a child, a gentle, playful smile.
private: Cooking the one dish he knows: a loose cream shirt with the sleeves rolled, a dark apron, black trousers, soft slippers, the violet hair tied back loosely. He holds a ladle to his lips, tasting soup, a quiet, wistful look.
battle: Laying out his shadow before the camp gate, in the shadow-laying robe made from the king's robe his troupe once sewed for him: a long trailing robe of deep violet velvet with a high stiff collar, closing down the front with tarnished gold buttons, worked all over with faded royal gold embroidery and lined with night-black silk, over a fitted breastplate of black-enamelled steel chased with small glowing amber lamp shapes; long gold-cuffed sleeves, black gloves; the glowing star emblem at the collar. He holds one palm turned downward, the long hem and sleeves pouring out into flowing living shadow like black cloth, rows of small low amber lamps glimmering inside it, a calm, gentle look.
formal: At the guild's rite of the emblem: a black velvet dress coat with a high collar, wine-red silk lining and gold buttons, a cream cravat, black gloves, polished boots, the star emblem at the breast. He makes a slow, deep stage bow with one hand over his heart, a courteous, gently amused look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the wine-red eyes looking at the viewer softly, as if about to finish a dream for them. Low amber lamplight from one side and deep violet fog on the other. Foreground blur: drifting fog, a small cloth bird with a yawning beak and a fold of dark stage curtain. He wears the long dark violet coat with gold-braided cuffs.
gear: 传奇（撼世）｜贫｜法袍｜5档｜474年凝名、到撼世；剧团出身，不靠披甲，战装就是剧团那一件国王袍改的铺影长袍（页上写的），照第五档用好料子、里头只加一副黑漆轻胸甲，招牌是那一身袍子和影子里的低灯。

name: 茜诺雅·汐鳍
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_三_繁荣的年月.md:3568
who: Sinoa Tidefin, a sea-born scale-folk diver of the north shore of the Salt Sea who dives for what people drop into the water, and who led a flood of red brine out of her town by singing the water open; she is called the Red Channel and has looked in her twenties ever since: about 172 cm, a swimmer's long, strong body. Long coral-pink hair parted into two bunches at the nape. Sea-green eyes.
